title: Version 1.61.0
html:
Version 1.61.0

July 4th, 2024

Added:

  • The fireworks have returned for a limited time, along with a new firework: 'OL FAITHFUL. The fireworks will be here for 2 weeks!
  • Added MULTI-SELECT! Select multiple schematics/structures all at once
  • New placement system handles! They should look a lot more visually pleasing
  • Added posters, a form of paintings that do not have a border
  • 3 new special paintings have been added to the game, they're hidden around the map for purchasing! All created by i5ene, fireparakeet, (casualcryptic and atlasplaisted)
  • Added the Player Cannon, obtainable through the Pirate Boat!
  • New schematic types have been added, found at Illumine Designs: Thin Tube, Macaroni, Thin Macaroni, Pentagon, Hexagon, and Octagon!
  • Filling in schematics with materials now has a cool consumption effect
  • The living axe now makes the trees retain their leaves!
  • New ban wave system & join data logging
  • Added an explosive wall to the Flowering Meadows entrance, and added a new 'free' entrance by the Emberbane quest area

Changes:

  • Removed the deletion build mode, as multi-select can now destroy multiple structures
  • The shoplifter achievement now only lets you steal up to $500,000 at a time before maxing out
  • Anchored materials can no longer fill into schematics
  • Gave a white stroke to the content amount labels on boxes
  • An interactor can now despawn vehicles & trailers with a power of 20
  • Meteors now have 50% ash tree, and will have a meteor core 100% of the time
  • Made Uranium more rare in the desert regions
  • Removed the king
  • Made all guns legal
  • Capitalized on tons of oil
  • Flooded a harbor with tea

Fixes:

  • Fixed the anchoring tool anchoring based on server position
  • Boomite & Tumbleweeds now have a translation string
  • Fixed the miner's helmet breaking on reset
  • Fixed rocks not fully finishing their destruction cycle when completely destroyed
  • Fixed Cobalt not being able to spawn in desert regions

Version 1.61.1

July 4th, 2024

Fixed:

  • Fixed issue with in-proper tap proccessing

Version 1.61.2

July 5th, 2024

Changes:

  • Multi-select is now an option that has to be enabled in the build mode
  • Improved performance of rocks that had ore pieces on them when in vehicles

Fixes:

  • Multiple bug fixes with the new placement system
  • Fixed the blueprint fabricator not being able to select the newest schematics
